query-mapping.description: List of changes to report for notifications

property.name: date
property.comment: the date when the change was made.

property.name: kind
property.comment: the field name that was changed.

property.name: field
property.comment: the field name that was changed.

query.name: audit-list
query.comment: Get the list of changes made after some date
query.sql: SELECT audit.date, e.id, field.name, audit.entity_id, audit.old_value, audit.new_value FROM awa_audit AS audit INNER JOIN ado_entity_type AS e ON audit.entity_type = e.id LEFT JOIN awa_audit_field AS field ON audit.field = field.id WHERE audit.date >= :date
